items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Well, we used to use a piano player, he died, called Tink... We used to Tink the most of the time.

ctx.x: No real member of your band was a piano player. No. It was a different guy. Different guy. Who would you use, just for example?

Well, we used to use a piano player, he died, called Tink. Oh, Tink. Oh, yeah. You heard that, didn't you? Oh, yeah. Sure. Well, he was a good thing. Mm-hmm. We used to Tink the most of the time. Did you have a saxophone or a trombone? No. We had a trombone. Trombone was a bopo and a bopo. Eddie Bo Bo Bo.
Oh, yeah. What's the trombone was a bopo? Did you have a, ever used a violin in the band? No, there was no violin. Mm-hmm.
